verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a full OpenAPI spec and offers wrangler CLI/SDK that let developers deploy and manage Workers entirely without the dashboard, and community reports confirm production use via API/CLI alone. However, there's no direct evidence confirming 100% UI/API feature parity, and some comments note friction (lack of full Node runtime, vendor lock-in with D1/KV) suggesting gaps in programmatic control of some platform features.
